requiredScenarios.description: Terminate a production-path process without a graceful shutdown and prove durable, duplicate-safe recovery.
Interrupt a production-path network dependency and prove bounded detection, reconnection, and progress recovery.
Reach a controlled storage hard limit, prove fail-closed behaviour, release capacity, and resume without data loss.
Rotate a live production-path credential, reject the retired credential, and resume with the replacement.
Replace the active PostgreSQL primary and prove role-compatible routing plus source and checkpoint continuity.
Inject backward and forward UTC movement through an isolated clock boundary and prove ordering and expiry safety.
Move between two distinct minor releases of one supported PostgreSQL major and prove state and checkpoint continuity.
